description: Get news headlines and articles — world news, breaking news, and business/financial/stock-market news. Filter by keyword, country (2-letter, e.g. "us"), category (business, technology, politics, sports, health, science), and language. IMPORTANT: for stock-market / financial-market / economy / "world market news" questions, ALWAYS pass category: "business" — it returns real market-news outlets and filters out low-quality SEO/crypto-promo articles. Returns article title, description, link, source, publish date, category, and country. Paginate via the nextPage token. WITHOUT from_date/to_date this covers only roughly the LAST 48 HOURS (NewsData.io's rolling "latest" feed) — asking about an older event with no date window silently returns today's unrelated articles instead of an empty result. For a PAST date range, pass from_date/to_date (YYYY-MM-DD): this routes to NewsData.io's archive endpoint, which requires a plan tier above the shared platform key's default — if the account cannot serve it, the call returns a `filter_gap` field naming the unsupported window instead of silently substituting the latest 48h. Examples: latest_news({ query: "stock market", category: "business" }) for current world market news; latest_news({ query: "election", country: "us", category: "politics" }); latest_news({ query: "Houthi Yemen attack", from_date: "2026-08-01", to_date: "2026-08-15" }) for an August event.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own NewsData.io API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

category.description: News category, e.g. "business", "technology", "politics", "sports", "health", "science". OMIT unless confident — a wrong category guess returns 0 results (e.g. drug-approval and pharma-industry stories are categorized "business", not "health").

country.description: 2-letter country code to filter news by, e.g. "us", "gb", "in"

from_date.description: Start of a PAST date window, YYYY-MM-DD. Supplying this (or to_date) switches the call from the 48h "latest" feed to NewsData.io's archive endpoint, which may require a higher plan tier than the shared platform key has — if so, the response carries `filter_gap` naming the unsupported window rather than silently returning current articles.

language.description: Language code to filter news by, e.g. "en", "es", "fr"

page.description: nextPage token returned from a prior call, to fetch the next page of results

query.description: Keywords to search news articles for. Every term is AND-ed — each word must appear in the article — so use 1-3 distinctive keywords ("NMPA approval biotech", "AI chips") rather than a full phrase; "Chinese biotech out-licensing deals NMPA approvals" returns 0 results while "NMPA Chinese biotech" returns articles.

to_date.description: End of a PAST date window, YYYY-MM-DD. See from_date.

name: latest_news
title: Latest News
